oauth.title: Authorized sessions
oauth.description: Each successful OAuth login creates one session. Refreshing or copying a token does not create another device.
oauth.revokeDescription: Revoke {{client}}? Its access and refresh tokens will stop working. Already started responses may finish.

consent.title: Authorize application
consent.description: Sign in to your GPROXY account, not an upstream provider.
consent.permissionsDescription: Discover and run models currently allowed for your account. No administrator or account-management access is granted.
consent.identityWarning: The application name and client ID are labels, not proof that the requesting application is trustworthy. Only approve a login you initiated.
consent.loadError: This authorization is invalid, expired, or no longer available.
consent.saveError: Could not complete authorization. Try again.
consent.returnToClient: Return to the application. You can close this page.

login.description: Sign in with the account created by your administrator.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Create keys for API clients or Codex access-token login.
keys.label: Label
keys.created: Copy this key now. It will not be shown again.
keys.revealed: Key revealed. It will be masked again shortly.
keys.revealError: Could not reveal this key. Retry.
keys.copyError: Could not copy the key. Select it and copy manually.
keys.modelsHint: Only the checked models this key may call. None = inherit account.
keys.mcpHint: Servers this key may call, with the tool-name patterns allowed on each. Nothing checked means this key reaches no MCP tools — models above fall back to your account, MCP does not.
keys.mcpError: Could not load MCP access for this key.
keys.mcpPatternHint: A pattern matches the tool's own name; * allows every tool on that server.

password.title: Password
password.description: Change the password used to sign in to this portal.

overview.title: Welcome, {{name}}
overview.description: Manage your keys, connect your tools, and track settled spend.

connect.title: Connect
connect.description: Choose an allowed model, then copy a ready-to-run example.
connect.noCompatibleExamplesDescription: This model is allowed, but none of the supported client wire formats match these examples.
connect.copyError: Could not copy. Try again in a secure browser context.
connect.mcpDescription: The same API key also reaches the gateway's MCP endpoint: the client connects to one URL and sees exactly the tools this key was granted.
connect.mcpHint: Tool access is configured under API keys — expand a key and pick MCP tool access. Tools you were not granted never appear in the client's list.

models.emptyDescription: Ask the operator to expose a route and grant your account access.

usage.title: Usage and cost
usage.description: Settled usage for your account over the selected range.
usage.trendDescription: Requests per hour in the selected range.
usage.byModelDescription: Requests, tokens and cost by upstream model.

recent.title: Recent settled requests
recent.description: The latest settled requests for your account. Request and response bodies are never shown here.
recent.loadError: Could not load recent requests. Retry.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage the password you sign in with and your display preferences.
settings.appearanceDescription: Theme and language apply to this browser only.

sessions.title: Authorized sessions
sessions.description: Applications you have signed in to with OAuth. Revoke one to cut off its access and refresh tokens.

providers.pageDescription: Manage upstream providers, their API keys, and the models exposed to clients.
providers.loadError: Could not load management data. Retry.
providers.name: Name
providers.label: Label
providers.modelHint: The model ID is what clients call via the API; the display name is shown here.
providers.deleteProviderBody: Delete {{name}}? Its keys and any model sources that reference it will be removed.
providers.deleteModelBody: Delete {{name}} and all of its sources?
providers.secretHint: Leave the fields blank to keep the current secret.
providers.discoverError: Could not reach the provider. Check its key and URL.
providers.weightHint: Share of traffic when the provider has several keys (higher = more requests).
providers.rpmHint: Max requests per minute for this key. Leave blank for no limit.
providers.tpmHint: Max tokens per minute for this key. Leave blank for no limit.
providers.testRunning: Testing… this takes a few seconds.
providers.translateHint: Enable for upstreams without the OpenAI Responses API (e.g. Zhipu's coding endpoint) — Responses clients then work via conversion.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.description: Upstream MCP servers gproxy aggregates. Each key is granted servers and tool patterns separately; connect clients to /mcp with a key.
mcp.deleteServerBody: Delete {{name}}? Every key's grants on it are removed too.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.tokenKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored token
mcp.noTools: No tools discovered yet — run Discover.
